propositions: Three near-identical detached-child spawn sites (push.py, enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py) independently replicate PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, cwd handling, and never-raise wrapper logic

A cwd omission bug propagated identically across all three sites by deliberate code copying, demonstrating that having multiple implementations of the same pattern creates maintenance risk and defect multiplication
A fourth detached spawn site (gc_trigger.py) emerged during review with identical copy-pasted pattern, confirming that the structural duplication invites uncontrolled replication

The consolidation must preserve per-caller exception handling (push.py catches OSError, drain/sweep catch broad Exception), per-caller env construction (push.py secret-strips, others use plain environ), and per-caller log sinks
A static test must enforce that detached-spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appear only in _proc.py to prevent future copy-paste sites
_proc.py must remain a stdlib-only leaf with no rebar.* imports while centralizing all detached rebar child spawn logic
